question: Which team won the Ranji Trophy 2022/23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saurashtra**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Saurashtra won the Ranji Trophy 2022/23, defeating Bengal in the final by 9 wickets.
 
• This was their second Ranji Trophy title
 
• The final match between Saurashtra and Bengal was a closely contested affair.
 
• However, Saurashtra's strong performance, especially in the first innings, proved to be decisive.
